newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian Medienos Plausas 1996 profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian Medienos Plausas 1996 profit falls.

text.p: Key Lithuanian stock market company, cardboard manufacturer Medienos Plausas, saw a fall in 1996 profit to 2.61 million litas from 5.95 million litas in 1995, the company said on Thursday.
The company also said in a statement of unaudited results that its turnover was 41.82 million litas in 1996 and its gross profit was 8.96 million litas last year.
It provided no other comparisons for the figures.
Operating profit came to 2.95 million litas and year profit before taxes was 3.03 million litas, the company said.
The company is one of the leading shares on the Lithuanian stock exchange and is expected to be included on the official list soon.
